cases.description: single item -> tagged with bucket_file_id recovered via itemMatching against this SAME workflow's own trigger (safe: no Execute Workflow boundary crossed between trigger and this node)
multiple items -> each tagged with its OWN corresponding trigger item's bucket_file_id, by index, not all collapsed to the same one

an item that already carries a (stale) bucket_file_id -> still unconditionally overwritten by itemMatching; this node always re-derives, unlike file-content-extractor.json's Ensure Bucket File ID, which prefers an already-correct value
